content: No, that statement is not accurate. The retirement age for women in Switzerland is gradually being aligned with that of men through a legal reform. As of now, women born between 1960 and 1969 will retire between the ages of 64 and 65, depending on their birth year. The goal is to have both men and women retire at age 65 by the year 2024. Women born before 1960 have already retired at an earlier age (typically 62 or 63). Therefore, not all women in Switzerland retire at 64—this is a transitional phase.
